body.label: Target
body.html: One creature within weapon range and line of sight.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On a success, deal 1 weapon damage. If the target is Locked by you, ignore 1 Defense from cover and increase this Action's range by 3 units.

surges.html: If the primary target is Locked by you, deal +1 weapon damage.
After this resolves, move up to 2 units without triggering Reactions caused by leaving cover or reach.

rider.title: TARGETING
rider.html: If the target is Locked by you and this Action succeeds, your next Ballistics Action against it this turn ignores 1 Defense from cover.
